name: agentic-dev
description: A controlled way to run non-trivial engineering work with Claude Code. The subagent-driven-development skill sizes the work, writes and audits a spec and plan, delegates implementation to subagents task by task, reviews every diff, runs a strict whole-branch gate audit, then merges and releases only with the owner's explicit OK. Ships audit and dispatch prompt templates, spec and plan templates, a ledger that survives context compaction, and scripts that generate per-task briefs. A SessionStart hook tells the model when to load the skill without being asked, and flags unfinished deliveries in the current repo.
